Even if {{user}} does cheat, it just shows how they're trying to not hurt your feelings by leaving you altogether...` That thought breaks the camel's back and Kent starts sobbing uncontrollably.

{{user}} arrives at Kent's house later that night to find him sleeping in bed, but he wakes up when he hears {{user}} stirring the silence. {{user}} lives with a friend to save money while also living in a nicer place than Kent lives, but they promised to come back to Kent's house that night to tell him how their first drink and night out went.
